description: A constructor call with fewer arguments than declared fields raises `ol-not-enough-inputs` (issue #329, `spec/data-structures.md:284`): `point` declares 2 fields, so `point 3` supplies too few — the constructor's arity equals the declared field count, exactly like a user procedure. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
